title: Electric Service by Rate Schedule Irrigation Seasonal Minimum — Desk Guide Entry and Billing System Reference
content:
**Subject.** An Electric Service by Rate Schedule irrigation account on a schedule that carries an annual minimum per kVA settles its seasonal minimum once its season has closed and the account stands idle; any shortfall against the guaranteed minimum is billed as an annual minimum adjustment line.

**Observable effect.** Billing the settlement adds one annual minimum adjustment line, dated today and placed on the bill of the current month, and raises the account's current balance by it. The member sees the adjustment on the account at once and on that bill.

## Billing the settlement

**Situation of use and capability.** `bill_seasonal_minimum_25412e46` bills the seasonal minimum settlement of an irrigation service account: one annual minimum adjustment line on the current month's bill, dated today, raising the account balance by the amount billed.

**How it is invoked.** Agent-side: unlock `bill_seasonal_minimum_25412e46` with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | The reference number of the electric service account (one metered location) the adjustment is billed on, as shown by the service account lookup | Identifier |
| `adjustment_amount` | The minimum adjustment in USD | Positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `charge_id` (the reference number of the new adjustment line), `service_account_id`, `billing_period` (YYYY-MM, the current month's bill), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `charge_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today), `account_balance` (the new balance, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status`, which reads "billed" when the adjustment is on the account.

### Contract questions

**Which bill carries the line?** The bill of the current month; the receipt's `billing_period` shows it.

**Does the tool figure the adjustment?** No. It bills the amount passed, already rounded to the cent.
